name: gob.pe
body: A meta description on every page analyzed, full share cards, real 404s, and every internal link opened answered. But the plain-http address serves the whole portal with a 200, no redirect, so typed addresses stay unencrypted.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with a 301. HSTS only protects people who have visited before.
summary: www.gob.pe scores 71 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 22 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 22 form controls have no label
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 200. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: 2 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: HWWAFSESID, HWWAFSESTIME. Without HttpOnly: HWWAFSESID. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /busquedas?contenido%5B%5D=servicios, /estado/poder-ejecutivo and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 1 title is shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "Plataforma del Estado Peruano" on /, /busquedas?contenido%5B%5D=servicios, /estado/poder-ejecutivo and 12 more.
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: 12 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /busquedas?contenido%5B%5D=servicios, /estado/poder-ejecutivo, /transformaciondigital and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
Every page has a meta description
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
